limits: Only native C1.2-connected generated GND shapes/manualclines/pads/vias in coplanar union; static oscillator island deliberately excluded even though singleanchor gives common net.
Arc conversion mm4/signedquadrant contract, eachnativearea error<.01mm2; .0001mm boundary tolerance only in projection screen.
Coplanar pad bbox is conservative copper approximation; solid via disk used for geometric adjacency, ignores drill/barrel/3D inductance.
Width-core is 2D morphological local diagnostic: positive does not certify minimum manufacturedneck/HFreturn; negative needs topology review, cannot override nativegraph.
Distances are descriptive, no universal1.5mm pass criterion, no90ohm/USBcompliance/EMI/SIcertification.
